integrity: The proof uses exact rational arithmetic and a symbolic Bloch-vector inequality. No finite numerical scan is used to establish the universal product-state bound.
scientific_limitations: The counterexample addresses Conjecture V.6 as written at Rényi orders \((2,2)\). It does not refute the later Shannon additivity theorem and does not decide a repaired conjecture restricted to dual Rényi pairs.
title: A two-qubit Rényi-2 counterexample to product-state entropy-diagram factorization
